name: CropTextNode
label: Crop Text
description: Extracts text before, after, or between specified flags.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: OriginalText
fields.label: Original Text
fields.description: The full text value from which to extract a portion.

fields.name: Mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to crop the text relative to the flag(s).

selectOptions.label: Before Flag
selectOptions.description: Get text before the first occurrence of the flag.

selectOptions.label: After Flag
selectOptions.description: Get text after the last occurrence of the flag.

fields.name: Flag
fields.label: Flag
fields.description: The flag used to locate the text to extract. Required in 'Before Flag' and 'After Flag' modes.

fields.name: SecondFlag
fields.label: Second Flag
fields.description: The second flag used in 'Between Flags' mode to mark the end of the extracted text.

fields.name: IgnoreCase
fields.label: Ignore Case
fields.description: When true, ignores case when matching flags.

fields.name: CroppedText
fields.label: Cropped Text
fields.description: The extracted portion of the original text based on the specified mode.

fields.name: IsFlagFound
fields.label: Is Flag Found
fields.description: Indicates whether the specified flag(s) were found in the original text.
